question: Team IS1006 agreed on an energy source in meeting c. How did it change in meeting d, and how did the team get from its 17.8 Euro estimate down to the budget?
answer: In meeting c they agreed on 2 batteries and no solar; in meeting d they switched to a hand dynamo generating electricity from button presses, then settled on combining it with a battery but removing one source to stay on target. To address the €17.8 estimate against the €12.50 budget, they identified the LCD and speaker as the costly items and discussed choosing one or the other, then removed one of the dynamo/battery items when the combined setup exceeded the limit; the transcript does not establish that this alone reduced the total to €12.50.
